correctness.rationale: From exact moment feasible constraints, off-diagonal removal is improving and attainable, forcing full budget and a strictly convex reciprocal-sum minimization. Its clipped minimizer gives every regime with sharp equality boundaries. Prescribed deterministic controls impose cross moment squared hqp; fixed-q fractional linearity, monotonic q at p=0 and strict convexity of the full-budget determinant imply pure-stage optima and the s(2+h) switch. Uniqueness of diagonal optimal covariance establishes the strict gap, and asymptotic endpoint reciprocals give the unbounded ratio. All critical formulas checked using standalone exact rational program; proof is analytical.
